newsitem.title: GERMANY: Badenwerk sells engineering unit to Wirtgen.
newsitem.headline: Badenwerk sells engineering unit to Wirtgen.

text.p: German energy company Badenwerk AG said on Monday it had sold a 21 percent share in the Mannheim-based construction equipment manufacturer Joseph Voegele AG to road builder Joseph Wirtgen.
Windhagen-based Wirtgen already owns 25 percent of Voegele shares. Wirtgen said its target with the acquisition was to increase sales and secure jobs at the company.

Badenwerk said it had been holding the shares as an investment. In the first half of 1996, Voegele sales fell 14.7 percent to 71.1 million marks, while net profits fell nearly a third to one million marks.
